# FamilyFlix long-form playback fixture

`rights-cleared-long-form.mp4` is a synthetic 90-minute test video created solely
for testing server-side torrent streaming, byte-range seeking, and the existing
FamilyFlix player. Its frames are generated from a flat color background and a
moving geometric shape. It contains no third-party footage, soundtrack, or
other borrowed material.

The fixture is dedicated to the public domain under
[CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). The runtime and
source are intentionally synthetic; this fixture is not a commercial film and
does not establish rights to any imported catalog title.
